newsitem.title: USA: Columbia Banking declares stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Columbia Banking declares stock dividend.

text.p: Columbia Banking System Inc has declared a five percent stock dividend on the company's common stock.
The dividend will be payable May 22 to shareholders of record as of May 8, 1997. It was the company's second dividend since its initial public offering in June 1992.
"We are very pleased with the growth and increased profitability Columbia Bank has achieved since our major expansion into Pierce County in 1993," said President W. W. Philip in a press release.

"In order to continue that growth, our business plans call for conserving our capital base. Therefore, rather than reducing capital by issuing a cash dividend, we are pleased to reward our shareholders with additional stock in the company."
Columbia Banking System is a bank holding company which operates Columbia Bank, a state-chartered full-service commercial bank with 18 branches.
